rubick_curiosity.name: Curiosity
rubick_curiosity.description:
Rubick gains %curiosity_per_level% stack of Curiosity per level that grants him %curiosity_attack_damage% base damage, %curiosity_modifier_amp%%% Buff/Debuff Duration, and %curiosity_aoe_bonus% AOE Bonus.

If Rubick sees an enemy Hero cast an ability within %charge_radius% distance of him, he gains %curiosity_per_spell_cast% Curiosity for %curiosity_duration% seconds. If an enemy Hero dies while Rubick has Curiosity from them and he damaged them in the last %grace_period% seconds, he gains %curiosity_per_kill% Curiosity permanently.

rubick_telekinesis.name: Telekinesis
rubick_telekinesis.description: Rubick uses his telekinetic powers to lift the enemy into the air briefly and then hurls them back at the ground. The unit lands on the ground with such force that it stuns nearby enemies.
rubick_telekinesis.shard_description: Allows you to target yourself or allies with Telekinesis. Throw distance is increased to %max_land_distance% and throw delay is reduced to %shard_teammate_throw_delay% seconds.
rubick_telekinesis.lore: Even the Grandest Magus may use his powers for enjoyment.
rubick_telekinesis.note0: While the target is in the air, Rubick may use a secondary ability to throw the enemy in a targeted direction.
rubick_telekinesis.note1: When the unit lands, it isn't affected by the area of effect stun.
rubick_telekinesis.land_description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_self_description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_custom_description: Chooses the location the target will land when Telekinesis finishes.
rubick_telekinesis.land_self_custom_description: Chooses the location you will land when Telekinesis finishes.

rubick_fade_bolt.name: Fade Bolt
rubick_fade_bolt.description: Rubick creates a powerful stream of arcane energy that travels between enemy units, dealing damage and reducing their attack and spell damage. Each jump deals less damage.
rubick_fade_bolt.lore: Rubick's favorite spell for dispatching would-be assassins is a rather simple conjuration.

rubick_arcane_supremacy.name: Arcane Supremacy
rubick_arcane_supremacy.description: Rubick's mastery of the arcane allows him to have a larger cast range and bonus spell amplification.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.facet_rubick_arcane_accumulation: Casting a spell temporarily increases the area of effect for all subsequent spells.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.lore: Not every magus can be a Grand Magus...
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note0: Break disables the gaining of new Arcane Accumulation stacks.
rubick_arcane_supremacy.note1: Break does not disable the bonuses from existing Arcane Accumulation stacks.

rubick_spell_steal.name: Spell Steal
rubick_spell_steal.description: Rubick studies the trace magical essence of one enemy hero, learning the secrets of the last spell the hero cast. Rubick can use this spell as his own for several minutes or until he dies.
rubick_spell_steal.facet_rubick_frugal_filch: Stolen spells also have lower mana cost.
rubick_spell_steal.scepter_description: Increases the number of spells that can be stolen to 2. Increases cast range, and upgrades stolen spells to their Scepter version.
rubick_spell_steal.shard_description: Upgrades stolen spells to their Shard version.
rubick_spell_steal.lore: ...but even their lesser magics can be a source of much utility.
rubick_spell_steal.note1: Not all abilities can be stolen.
